subject: Remove unnecessary argument(tp) in gettimeofday() call for retrieving timezone (#12722)
reason: The change edits only the non-Linux/non-Solaris branch of getTimeZone() in src/util.c, replacing gettimeofday(&tv, &tz) with gettimeofday(NULL, &tz). On Linux (where the fuzzer runs) this code is excluded by the preprocessor, so the builds under test are byte-for-byte equivalent on this path; and even where compiled, passing NULL for the timeval is semantically identical — the timezone struct is filled the same and the return value is unchanged. It is a pure refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario can reach or distinguish it.
